lines: Oh! A new face in Knitting Class. Sit, sit!
I'm Granny Purl. This little rascal on my shoulder is Snag.
Every stitch holds the next one up, dearie.
Drop one and the whole row wobbles. A bit like time, really.
Snag! Stop eating the blue wool!

rotate: Knit one, purl one, and never rush the yarn.
Snag's knitting a scarf. It's mostly knots.
Mind the yarn on the floor, dear. Snag sets traps.
A mistake's just a stitch you haven't fixed yet.
Now, where did I put my other needle? Oh, it's in my hair.
Snag! Give that back! That's a student's shoelace!
(Snag hides behind her bun and giggles.)
